itinerary.title: The itinerary of a trip
itinerary.summary: The legs of the journey, each with the local time and, beside it, the time in Romania. You can import a booking instead of typing it.
itinerary.keywords: itinerary trip travel leg flight time zone import booking ics confirmation
itinerary.where: Your occasion → Itinerary and rooms → Itinerary

ol1.a: Open “Itinerary and rooms” and go to “Itinerary”.
ol1.b: Press “Add a leg” and say what it is, from where, to where and at what times.
ol1.c: Repeat for each flight, train, drive or stay.

body.note1: Every time is shown in the local zone and, beside it, in Romanian time. The date of the occasion is in Romanian time; each leg keeps the time zone of its place.

ol2.b: Paste the confirmation you received or choose the .ics file (under 300 KB). The file is read on your device.
ol2.d: Check the preview and confirm it.

body.note2: We read only what is certain — dates, times, flight numbers, the booking code. What we cannot read with certainty is left for you to fill in; we do not guess.
body.p1: The main “Itinerary and rooms” page shows you the next leg, or the one under way, with both times.

trip-groups-rooms.title: Groups, packing, transport and rooms
trip-groups-rooms.summary: You split people into groups, cars and rooms, without a seat or a bed ever being given twice.
trip-groups-rooms.keywords: groups activities packing list transport cars minibus seats rooms accommodation beds settlement
trip-groups-rooms.need: The occasion's planning team. “Settlement” needs the “Finance” access.

ul1.a: “Groups and activities” — press “Add a group” to split people into smaller groups and “Add an activity” for things anyone can sign up for.
ul1.b: “Packing” — press “New list”. Each list is a task with ticks: you also find it under “Tasks”, with the same ticks.
ul1.c: “Transport” — press “Add a vehicle” for cars, minibuses or transfers and see who travels with what.
ul1.d: “Rooms” — press “Add a room”, then choose the room, tick the people and press “Place here”.
ul1.e: “Settlement” — who paid, who owes and who gives whom, separately for each currency.

body.note1: A seat in a car is taken once, even if two people press at the same moment. In the same way a bed cannot be given twice: the second person sees how many are left.
body.p1: If you tick, for a room, someone already placed in another, you move them to the new room.
body.note2: Settlement uses the same ledger as “Shared costs”. Amounts in different currencies are not mixed.
